utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the porch gate, two cracked fence panels, and a leaky faucet by the side yard.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. What parts do we need to buy or bring for those repairs?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d help a lot, thanks. I might need a wrench and whatever else you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, I can lend you a wrench and a few other basics too. I’ll bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I’m still waiting on the latest word. I’ll tell you as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess. I’m mostly worried about timing and whether there’ll be enough people to handle everything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I’m hearing too. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I get a clearer count on people and timing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s the streetlight at Maple and 3rd that’s flickering, and my porch step needs tightening too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll check on both. I’ll start with the streetlight at Maple and 3rd, then I’ll take a look at your porch step.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive is tomorrow afternoon, right? I’ve already told a few people, and I can help spread the word more.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and let people know they’re welcome to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll keep the list organized and follow up on the remaining repairs so we can keep momentum.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the loose siding and the porch light, I think. I can check the list again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, can you check the list again so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school pickup, but I need the exact repair window first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll send the repair window as soon as I confirm it, but it should be this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I only got the secondhand version. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s moving ahead. I heard the repair drive is set up to help with the usual house fixes, and I can check who’s organizing what if you want the newest details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help. Who’s organizing it, and what fixes are they prioritizing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help, but keep it quick - what part of the repair drive needs me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just the front brake line on the repair drive - can you confirm you can handle that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes - I can handle the front brake line.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly the fence gate and the porch light, I think.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the porch light first, then we can check the gate.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Tell Cleo I’m in and I’ll follow up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Vik. I’ll keep track and send over the repair drive details shortly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, thanks, Cleo. I’ll keep an eye out for the details and follow up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I could use a hand checking the list and the loose wiring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll help with the list and check the loose wiring after I’m done running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have missed the first bit, but I’m here now and I can help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Glad you’re here. We’re getting the repair drive going, and I’ll fill you in as we go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, Vik. Point me at the first task and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with that. What do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the tools and fittings, if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I think I’ve got those lying around. I’ll check the drive and bring over the tools and fittings.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare drill and a ladder if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be a big help, Gus. I’ll keep things simple and make a plan for who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Eli. Tell me what else you need and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll send around the list tonight so we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, send it over when you can and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive if you need another hand, Opal. I’ve got a few friends who might be able to pitch in too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be a big help. I can point you to the repair drive and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, send me to it and I’ll round up a couple more people who can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ve got the list ready and I’m checking who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep track of what’s still needed and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep you posted on the remaining needs and flag anything urgent.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening, but I only got the second-hand version. What's the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s moving ahead, but the details are still being sorted. I’m checking what’s covered and who needs help next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — keep me posted when you know what’s covered and who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly it’s the laundry room door and a loose kitchen cabinet hinge. If you’re free this weekend, I could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely, I can help this weekend. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs to be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm exactly what’s still broken before I say it needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check the obvious stuff first, but I still need you to point out what looks damaged so I don’t miss anything.
